text.name: Vileplume

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Allergy Flower
abilities.text: Each player can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Dazzling Pollen
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

text.name: Cleffa

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

text.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Miracle Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Special Condition. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

text.flavor: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

text.name: Pichu

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Pichu is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Pichu by attacks.

attacks.name: Playground
attacks.text: Each player may search his or her deck for as many Basic Pokémon as he or she likes, put them onto his or her Bench, and shuffle his or her deck afterward. (You put your Pokémon on the Bench first.) Pichu is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, it also surprises itself.

text.name: Zekrom

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bolt Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 40 damage to itself.

text.flavor: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

text.name: Solosis

attacks.name: Cell Culture
attacks.text: Search your deck for Solosis and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in space.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon and heal all damage from this Pokémon.

text.name: Reuniclus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 10 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

text.flavor: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

text.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Happy Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 3 damage counters from Chansey.

text.flavor: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

text.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a {Grass} Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.

text.name: Phanpy

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the number of damage counters on Phanpy.

text.flavor: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

text.name: Copycat
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) (If you choose a Stage 2 Pokémon in your hand, put that Pokémon on the Basic Pokémon instead of on a Stage 1 Pokémon.)

text.name: Professor Oak's New Theory
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Sage's Training
effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose any 2 cards you find there and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Seeker
effect: Each player returns 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. (You return your Pokémon first.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Twins
effect: You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent. Search your deck for any 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

attacks.name: Torrent Blade
attacks.text: Return 2 {Water} Energy attached to Suicune & Entei LEGEND to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bursting Inferno
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

rules.text: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Suicune & Entei LEGEND.
When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Torrent Blade
attacks.text: Return 2 {Water} Energy attached to Suicune & Entei LEGEND to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bursting Inferno
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

rules.text: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Suicune & Entei LEGEND.
When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Pokémon Collector
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Pokémon Communication
effect: Reveal a Pokémon in your hand and put it on top of your deck. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Rainbow Energy
effect: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (While not in play, Rainbow Energy counts as {Colorless} Energy.)

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Blissful Nurse
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Blissey from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may remove all damage counters from all of your Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy attached to those Pokémon that had any damage counters on them.

abilities.label: Poké-Body
abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: Any damage done to Donphan by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.name: Tropical Beach
effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may draw cards until he or she has 7 cards in his or her hand. If he or she does, that player's turn ends.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.
